notes.text: Anti-tank/anti-assassin anchor: torpedo Super bursts divers at point blank; aim at the middle of the hitbox to land every torpedo.
Wants walls: charges the bubble hidden, then rotates the aim onto the approach at max size. Wall-heavy Brawl Ball maps are his home (Barricade gadget covers the goal walk).
Terrible natural regeneration — long-range poke on open maps denies him entirely; Super self-heals up to 5600 when used defensively.
